flashcard_questions.q: Transverse waves that transfer energy from one place to another and can travel through a vacuum at the speed of light.
A wave in which the oscillations are perpendicular (at right angles) to the direction of energy transfer.
The speed at which all electromagnetic waves travel through a vacuum: 300,000,000 m/s (3 × 10⁸ m/s).

flashcard_questions.a: The continuous range of electromagnetic waves ordered by wavelength and frequency, from radio waves (longest wavelength) to gamma rays (shortest wavelength).
The number of waves passing a point per second, measured in hertz (Hz).
